quote.text: What can be said at all can be said clearly, and what we cannot talk about we must pass over in silence.
quote.author: Ludwig Wittgenstein, Tractatus Logico-Philosophicus (1921), Preface

stories.headline: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang eleven days after he resigned
stories.dek: The board’s unanimous vote on 23 November cited “input from senior levels of the United States government”; Huang faces three House committees behind closed doors on 1 December.

stories.kicker: Raising Them Well · Short Videos And Self-Harm
stories.headline: JAMA Pediatrics links compulsive short-video use to teen self-harm
stories.dek: A Chinese study of 10,048 pupils, published on 23 November, found each extra year of heavy, compulsive viewing raised the risk of a suicide attempt by 63 per cent.

stories.kicker: The Undercurrent · Gengoka, Putting It Into Words
stories.headline: A Tokyo publisher shortlists “gengoka” as a word of the year
stories.dek: Jiyu Kokumin Sha named the word for spelling things out among 30 nominees on 5 November, a week before the winners on 1 December; the national habit of sensing what is unsaid is losing ground.

stories.kicker: The World · Ukraine In The Mediterranean
stories.headline: Ukraine sinks Russian corvette Merkury in Libya’s Benghazi port
stories.dek: Volodymyr Zelensky said on 23 November that seven Ukrainian sea drones hit the 1,800-tonne warship at dawn the day before; Libya’s Presidential Council calls it aggression.

stories.headline: Singapore and China sign 29 agreements at the JCBC
stories.dek: Gan Kim Yong and Ding Xuexiang co-chaired the council on 23 November; Hainan becomes the first Chinese province cleared to send Singapore chilled poultry and eggs.

stories.headline: Chris King guarantees its Portland bicycle hubs for life
stories.dek: Its R45 rear hub costs US$580; in Singapore, JanjiRide charges S$140 and Custom Bike Co S$120 to lace a pair of wheels by hand.

stories.headline: Google’s Pixel Tag tracker sells in Singapore for S$44.99
stories.dek: Engadget scored the Android-only tag 8.3 out of 10 on 17 November; it has no keyring hole and a battery Google says lasts over a year.

stories.kicker: The Good Life · Roger W. Smith Series Seven
stories.headline: Roger W. Smith unveils the Series Seven tourbillon at 25
stories.dek: The Isle of Man maker showed two prototypes on 19 November; the price is on request, and he expects to make one or two a year.

stories.headline: Peter Farrelly’s I Play Rocky takes $9.3m in its wide opening
stories.dek: Amazon MGM’s film about Sylvester Stallone’s fight to make Rocky came second on 20–22 November, on 2,477 screens, with 90 per cent on Rotten Tomatoes.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · Nvidia Lifts Wall Street
stories.headline: Nvidia rehires Jensen Huang and the S&P 500 jumps 4.7%
stories.dek: Nvidia’s shares rose 31.5 per cent on 23 November and the Nasdaq 6.5; the VIX fear gauge fell a quarter, to 27, from Friday’s one-year high.

stories.headline: UT Austin’s Darmok beats every human at the Times crossword final
stories.dek: Liam Hughes, 29, became the youngest Times champion on 10 October in 10:05; the machine, entered outside the standings, finished the same three puzzles in 6:52.

stories.headline: Nature Medicine trial: weights protect strength on tirzepatide
stories.dek: In a University of Western Australia trial of 120 adults aged 50 to 70, published on 9 November, lifting three times a week cut lean-tissue loss by 1.09kg over 40 weeks.

stories.kicker: The Diary · Disney On Ice And Final Fantasy
stories.headline: Disney On Ice returns to Singapore Indoor Stadium in March
stories.dek: General sale for the 13–21 March run opens at 10am tomorrow; in Ueno, Tokyo, the Final Fantasy 40th-anniversary exhibition opens on 8 January.
